security.getUser: SELECT user_id, user_na, user_pw, status_id FROM "user" WHERE user_na = $1 AND user_pw = $2
security.insertUser: INSERT INTO "user" (user_na, user_pw, status_id) VALUES ($1, $2, $3) RETURNING user_id
security.listUsers: SELECT u.user_id, u.user_na, s.status_id, s.status_de, COALESCE(string_agg(p.profile_de, ', ' ORDER BY p.profile_id), '—') AS profiles, MAX(pe.person_id) AS person_id, COALESCE(MAX(pe.person_na || ' ' || pe.person_ln), '—') AS person_name, COALESCE(MAX(pe.person_ci), '—') AS person_ci FROM "user" u INNER JOIN status s ON s.status_id = u.status_id LEFT JOIN user_profile up ON up.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN profile p ON p.profile_id = up.profile_id LEFT JOIN person_user pu ON pu.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN person pe ON pe.person_id = pu.person_id WHERE ($1 = '' OR u.user_na ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR pe.person_na ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR pe.person_ln ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR pe.person_ci ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%') GROUP BY u.user_id, u.user_na, s.status_id, s.status_de ORDER BY u.user_id ASC
security.listProfiles: SELECT profile_id, profile_de FROM profile ORDER BY profile_id ASC
security.listUserProfiles: SELECT p.profile_id, p.profile_de FROM user_profile up INNER JOIN profile p ON p.profile_id = up.profile_id WHERE up.user_id = $1 ORDER BY p.profile_id ASC
security.listAccessibleSubsystems: SELECT DISTINCT s.sub_system_id, s.sub_system_de FROM sub_system s WHERE s.sub_system_id IN (SELECT o.sub_system_id FROM object o INNER JOIN method m ON m.object_id = o.object_id INNER JOIN permission_method pm ON pm.method_id = m.method_id WHERE pm.profile_id = $1 UNION SELECT op.sub_system_id FROM option op INNER JOIN permission_option po ON po.option_id = op.option_id WHERE po.profile_id = $1) ORDER BY s.sub_system_de
security.addUserProfile: INSERT INTO user_profile (user_id, profile_id) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT (user_id, profile_id) DO NOTHING
security.removeUserProfile: DELETE FROM user_profile WHERE user_id = $1 AND profile_id = $2
security.isPermissionMethod: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM method m INNER JOIN object o ON o.object_id = m.object_id WHERE m.method_id = $1 AND o.object_de = 'Permission') AS is_perm
security.grantMethod: INSERT INTO permission_method (profile_id, method_id) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT (profile_id, method_id) DO NOTHING
security.revokeMethod: DELETE FROM permission_method WHERE profile_id = $1 AND method_id = $2
security.insertProfile: INSERT INTO profile (profile_de) VALUES ($1) RETURNING profile_id
security.updateProfile: UPDATE profile SET profile_de = $2 WHERE profile_id = $1
security.countProfileUsers: SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS n FROM user_profile WHERE profile_id = $1
security.grantOption: INSERT INTO permission_option (profile_id, option_id) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT (profile_id, option_id) DO NOTHING
security.revokeOption: DELETE FROM permission_option WHERE profile_id = $1 AND option_id = $2
security.getOptionDe: SELECT option_de FROM option WHERE option_id = $1
security.listSubsystems: SELECT sub_system_id, sub_system_de FROM sub_system ORDER BY sub_system_id
security.listObjects: SELECT object_id, object_de FROM object WHERE sub_system_id = $1 ORDER BY object_de
security.listMethods: SELECT m.method_id, m.method_de, (pm.permission_method_id IS NOT NULL) AS granted FROM method m LEFT JOIN permission_method pm ON pm.method_id = m.method_id AND pm.profile_id = $2 WHERE m.object_id = $1 ORDER BY m.method_id
security.listOptions: SELECT op.option_id, op.option_de, (po.permission_option_id IS NOT NULL) AS granted FROM option op LEFT JOIN permission_option po ON po.option_id = op.option_id AND po.profile_id = $2 WHERE op.sub_system_id = $1 ORDER BY op.option_id
security.listPersons: SELECT pe.person_id, pe.person_ci, pe.person_na, pe.person_ln, COALESCE(pe.person_mail, '—') AS person_mail, COALESCE(pe.person_phone, '—') AS person_phone, COALESCE((SELECT string_agg(c.name, ', ' ORDER BY c.name) FROM person_charge pc INNER JOIN charge c ON c.id = pc.charge_id WHERE pc.person_id = pe.person_id), 'Sin cargo') AS charges, u.user_id AS linked_user_id, u.user_na AS linked_user FROM person pe LEFT JOIN person_user pu ON pu.person_id = pe.person_id LEFT JOIN "user" u ON u.user_id = pu.user_id WHERE ($1 = '' OR pe.person_na ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR pe.person_ln ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR pe.person_ci ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR pe.person_mail ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR pe.person_phone ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%') ORDER BY pe.person_na, pe.person_ln LIMIT $2
security.insertPerson: INSERT INTO person (person_ci, person_na, person_ln, person_mail, person_phone) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) RETURNING person_id
security.updatePerson: UPDATE person SET person_ci = $2, person_na = $3, person_ln = $4, person_mail = $5, person_phone = $6 WHERE person_id = $1
security.listCharges: SELECT id, name FROM charge ORDER BY id
security.listPersonCharges: SELECT pc.id, pc.charge_id, c.name FROM person_charge pc INNER JOIN charge c ON c.id = pc.charge_id WHERE pc.person_id = $1 ORDER BY c.name
security.addPersonCharge: INSERT INTO person_charge (person_id, charge_id) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT (person_id, charge_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id
security.removePersonCharge: DELETE FROM person_charge WHERE person_id = $1 AND charge_id = $2
security.getPersonIdByUser: SELECT person_id FROM person_user WHERE user_id = $1
security.listAudit: SELECT a.id, to_char(a.date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS date, to_char(a.hour, 'HH24:MI:SS') AS hour, a.action, a.description, u.user_na FROM audit a INNER JOIN "user" u ON u.user_id = a.user_id WHERE ($1::date IS NULL OR a.date >= $1::date) AND ($2::date IS NULL OR a.date <= $2::date) ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT $3

proyectos.listProyects: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.status_id, s.status_de, COALESCE((SELECT string_agg(pe.person_na || ' ' || pe.person_ln, ', ') FROM proyect_role pr INNER JOIN proyect_role_person prp ON prp.proyect_role_id = pr.id INNER JOIN person pe ON pe.person_id = prp.person_id WHERE pr.proyect_id = p.id AND pr.name = 'Líder'), '—') AS leader_na, (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM proyect_role pr2 INNER JOIN proyect_role_person prp2 ON prp2.proyect_role_id = pr2.id WHERE pr2.proyect_id = p.id) AS members FROM proyect p INNER JOIN status s ON s.status_id = p.status_id ORDER BY p.id DESC
proyectos.listProyectMembers: SELECT prp.id, pr.name AS role_de, pe.person_id, pe.person_na, pe.person_ln, COALESCE((SELECT string_agg(c.name, ', ' ORDER BY c.name) FROM person_charge pc INNER JOIN charge c ON c.id = pc.charge_id WHERE pc.person_id = pe.person_id), 'Sin cargo') AS charges FROM proyect_role pr INNER JOIN proyect_role_person prp ON prp.proyect_role_id = pr.id INNER JOIN person pe ON pe.person_id = prp.person_id WHERE pr.proyect_id = $1 ORDER BY pr.name, pe.person_na
proyectos.listPersons: SELECT pe.person_id, pe.person_na, pe.person_ln, COALESCE((SELECT string_agg(c.name, ', ' ORDER BY c.name) FROM person_charge pc INNER JOIN charge c ON c.id = pc.charge_id WHERE pc.person_id = pe.person_id), 'Sin cargo') AS charges FROM person pe ORDER BY pe.person_na, pe.person_ln
proyectos.listAssignableMembers: SELECT DISTINCT pe.person_id, pe.person_na, pe.person_ln FROM proyect_role_person prp INNER JOIN proyect_role pr ON pr.id = prp.proyect_role_id INNER JOIN person pe ON pe.person_id = prp.person_id INNER JOIN person_charge pc ON pc.person_id = pe.person_id WHERE pr.proyect_id = $1 AND pc.charge_id = $2 ORDER BY pe.person_na, pe.person_ln
proyectos.personHasCharge: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM person_charge WHERE person_id = $1 AND charge_id = $2) AS has
proyectos.getProyectLeaderPersonId: SELECT prp.person_id FROM proyect_role pr INNER JOIN proyect_role_person prp ON prp.proyect_role_id = pr.id WHERE pr.proyect_id = $1 AND pr.name = 'Líder' LIMIT 1
proyectos.getProyectRolePerson: SELECT prp.id, pr.proyect_id, pr.name AS role_name, prp.person_id FROM proyect_role_person prp INNER JOIN proyect_role pr ON pr.id = prp.proyect_role_id WHERE prp.id = $1
proyectos.countProyectLeaders: SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS n FROM proyect_role pr INNER JOIN proyect_role_person prp ON prp.proyect_role_id = pr.id WHERE pr.proyect_id = $1 AND pr.name = 'Líder'
proyectos.proyectHasHistory: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM report r INNER JOIN activity a ON a.id = r.activity_id WHERE a.proyect_id = $1 UNION SELECT 1 FROM team_notification WHERE proyect_id = $1 UNION SELECT 1 FROM chat_message WHERE proyect_id = $1) AS has_history
proyectos.getActivityAssignee: SELECT aa.id, a.proyect_id FROM activity_assignment aa INNER JOIN activity a ON a.id = aa.activity_id WHERE aa.id = $1
proyectos.getProyect: SELECT id, name, status_id FROM proyect WHERE id = $1
proyectos.insertProyect: INSERT INTO proyect (status_id, name) VALUES ($1, $2) RETURNING id
proyectos.setProyectStatus: UPDATE proyect SET status_id = $2 WHERE id = $1
proyectos.findProyectRole: SELECT id FROM proyect_role WHERE proyect_id = $1 AND name = $2
proyectos.insertProyectRole: INSERT INTO proyect_role (proyect_id, name) VALUES ($1, $2) RETURNING id
proyectos.insertProyectRolePerson: INSERT INTO proyect_role_person (proyect_role_id, person_id) VALUES ($1, $2) RETURNING id
proyectos.memberExists: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proyect_role_person prp INNER JOIN proyect_role pr ON pr.id = prp.proyect_role_id WHERE pr.proyect_id = $1 AND prp.person_id = $2) AS dup
proyectos.personExists: SELECT person_id FROM person WHERE person_id = $1
proyectos.listCharges: SELECT id, name FROM charge ORDER BY id
proyectos.createActivity: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS activity (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, proyect_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES proyect(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, description TEXT, hours INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, charge_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES charge(id), status_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES status(status_id) DEFAULT 1, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
proyectos.createActivityAssignment: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS activity_assignment (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, activity_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES activity(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, person_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES person(person_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, assigned_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UNIQUE(activity_id, person_id))
proyectos.createReport: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS report (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, activity_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES activity(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, person_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES person(person_id), percentage INT NOT NULL CHECK (percentage >= 50 AND percentage <= 100), description TEXT NOT NULL, completed BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
proyectos.insertActivity: INSERT INTO activity (proyect_id, name, description, hours, charge_id, status_id) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, 1) RETURNING id
proyectos.listActivities: SELECT a.id, a.proyect_id, a.name, a.description, a.hours, a.charge_id, ch.name AS charge_de, a.status_id, s.status_de, COALESCE(STRING_AGG(pe.person_na || ' ' || pe.person_ln, ', '), 'Sin asignar') AS assigned_to, (SELECT MAX(r.percentage) FROM report r WHERE r.activity_id = a.id) AS last_percentage, (SELECT r.completed FROM report r WHERE r.activity_id = a.id ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS completed FROM activity a INNER JOIN status s ON s.status_id = a.status_id INNER JOIN charge ch ON ch.id = a.charge_id LEFT JOIN activity_assignment aa ON aa.activity_id = a.id LEFT JOIN person pe ON pe.person_id = aa.person_id WHERE a.proyect_id = $1 GROUP BY a.id, a.proyect_id, a.name, a.description, a.hours, a.charge_id, ch.name, a.status_id, s.status_de ORDER BY a.id DESC
proyectos.assignActivity: INSERT INTO activity_assignment (activity_id, person_id) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT (activity_id, person_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id
proyectos.updateActivity: UPDATE activity SET name = $2, description = $3, hours = $4, charge_id = $5 WHERE id = $1
proyectos.listActivityAssignees: SELECT aa.id, pe.person_id, pe.person_na, pe.person_ln FROM activity_assignment aa INNER JOIN person pe ON pe.person_id = aa.person_id WHERE aa.activity_id = $1 ORDER BY pe.person_na, pe.person_ln
proyectos.checkActivityAssignment: SELECT id FROM activity_assignment WHERE activity_id = $1 AND person_id = $2
proyectos.getMyActivities: SELECT a.id, a.name, a.description, a.hours, a.status_id, p.name AS proyect_name FROM activity a INNER JOIN proyect p ON p.id = a.proyect_id INNER JOIN activity_assignment aa ON aa.activity_id = a.id WHERE aa.person_id = $1 ORDER BY a.id DESC
proyectos.insertReport: INSERT INTO report (activity_id, person_id, percentage, description, completed) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) RETURNING id
proyectos.listReports: SELECT r.id, r.percentage, r.description, r.completed, to_char(r.created_at, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') AS created_at, pe.person_na, pe.person_ln FROM report r INNER JOIN person pe ON pe.person_id = r.person_id WHERE r.activity_id = $1 ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
proyectos.updateActivityStatus: UPDATE activity SET status_id = $2 WHERE id = $1
proyectos.getActivity: SELECT a.*, p.name AS proyect_name FROM activity a INNER JOIN proyect p ON p.id = a.proyect_id WHERE a.id = $1
proyectos.createTeamNotification: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS team_notification (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, proyect_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES proyect(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, sender_user_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES "user"(user_id), message TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
proyectos.sendNotification: INSERT INTO team_notification (proyect_id, sender_user_id, message) VALUES ($1, $2, $3) RETURNING id
proyectos.listProyectNotifications: SELECT tn.id, tn.message, to_char(tn.created_at, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') AS created_at, COALESCE(pe.person_na || ' ' || pe.person_ln, u.user_na) AS sender FROM team_notification tn INNER JOIN "user" u ON u.user_id = tn.sender_user_id LEFT JOIN person_user pu ON pu.user_id = tn.sender_user_id LEFT JOIN person pe ON pe.person_id = pu.person_id WHERE tn.proyect_id = $1 ORDER BY tn.id DESC
proyectos.getMyNotifications: SELECT tn.id, tn.message, to_char(tn.created_at, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') AS created_at, p.name AS proyect_name, COALESCE(pe.person_na || ' ' || pe.person_ln, u.user_na) AS sender FROM team_notification tn INNER JOIN proyect p ON p.id = tn.proyect_id INNER JOIN "user" u ON u.user_id = tn.sender_user_id LEFT JOIN person_user pu ON pu.user_id = tn.sender_user_id LEFT JOIN person pe ON pe.person_id = pu.person_id WHERE tn.proyect_id IN (SELECT pr.proyect_id FROM proyect_role pr INNER JOIN proyect_role_person prp ON prp.proyect_role_id = pr.id WHERE prp.person_id = $1 UNION SELECT a.proyect_id FROM activity a INNER JOIN activity_assignment aa ON aa.activity_id = a.id WHERE aa.person_id = $1) ORDER BY tn.id DESC
proyectos.listTimesheetGeneral: SELECT r.id, r.percentage, r.description, r.completed, to_char(r.created_at, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') AS created_at, pe.person_na, pe.person_ln, a.name AS activity_name, p.name AS proyect_name FROM report r INNER JOIN activity a ON a.id = r.activity_id INNER JOIN proyect p ON p.id = a.proyect_id INNER JOIN person pe ON pe.person_id = r.person_id WHERE ($1::date IS NULL OR r.created_at::date >= $1::date) AND ($2::date IS NULL OR r.created_at::date <= $2::date) ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT $3
proyectos.listTimesheetByPerson: SELECT r.id, r.percentage, r.description, r.completed, to_char(r.created_at, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') AS created_at, a.name AS activity_name, p.name AS proyect_name FROM report r INNER JOIN activity a ON a.id = r.activity_id INNER JOIN proyect p ON p.id = a.proyect_id WHERE r.person_id = $1 AND ($2::date IS NULL OR r.created_at::date >= $2::date) AND ($3::date IS NULL OR r.created_at::date <= $3::date) ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT $4
proyectos.createChatMessage: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chat_message (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, proyect_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES proyect(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, sender_user_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES "user"(user_id), message TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
proyectos.sendChatMessage: INSERT INTO chat_message (proyect_id, sender_user_id, message) VALUES ($1, $2, $3) RETURNING id
proyectos.listChatMessages: SELECT cm.id, cm.message, to_char(cm.created_at, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') AS created_at, cm.sender_user_id, COALESCE(pe.person_na || ' ' || pe.person_ln, u.user_na) AS sender FROM chat_message cm INNER JOIN "user" u ON u.user_id = cm.sender_user_id LEFT JOIN person_user pu ON pu.user_id = cm.sender_user_id LEFT JOIN person pe ON pe.person_id = pu.person_id WHERE cm.proyect_id = $1 ORDER BY cm.id ASC
proyectos.listMyProyects: SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.name FROM proyect p WHERE p.id IN (SELECT pr.proyect_id FROM proyect_role pr INNER JOIN proyect_role_person prp ON prp.proyect_role_id = pr.id WHERE prp.person_id = $1 UNION SELECT a.proyect_id FROM activity a INNER JOIN activity_assignment aa ON aa.activity_id = a.id WHERE aa.person_id = $1) ORDER BY p.name

model.dropAll: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS chat_message, team_notification, report, activity_assignment, activity, proyect_role_person, proyect_role, proyect, person_charge, person_user, person, charge, projects, project_members, audit, permission_method, permission_option, user_profile, method, option, object, sub_system, subsystem, "user", users, profile, status CASCADE
model.createStatus: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS status (status_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, status_de VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL)
model.createProfile: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS profile (profile_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, profile_de VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL)
model.createSubSystem: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sub_system (sub_system_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, sub_system_de VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL)
model.createObject: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS object (object_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, object_de VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE NOT NULL, sub_system_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES sub_system(sub_system_id) ON DELETE CASCADE)
model.createMethod: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS method (method_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, method_de VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, object_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES object(object_id) ON DELETE CASCADE)
model.createOption: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS option (option_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, option_de VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, sub_system_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES sub_system(sub_system_id) ON DELETE CASCADE)
model.createUser: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user" (user_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_na VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE NOT NULL, user_pw VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, status_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES status(status_id))
model.createUserProfile: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_profile (user_profile_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES "user"(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, profile_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES profile(profile_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, UNIQUE (user_id, profile_id))
model.createPermissionMethod: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS permission_method (permission_method_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, profile_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES profile(profile_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, method_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES method(method_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, UNIQUE (profile_id, method_id))
model.createPermissionOption: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS permission_option (permission_option_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, profile_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES profile(profile_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, option_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES option(option_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, UNIQUE (profile_id, option_id))
model.createAudit: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES "user"(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, date DATE NOT NULL, hour TIME NOT NULL, action VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, description TEXT)
model.createCharge: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS charge (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL)
model.createPerson: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS person (person_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, person_ci VARCHAR(20) UNIQUE NOT NULL, person_na VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, person_ln VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, person_mail VARCHAR(100), person_phone VARCHAR(30))
model.createPersonCharge: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS person_charge (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, person_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES person(person_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, charge_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES charge(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, UNIQUE(person_id, charge_id))
model.createPersonUser: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS person_user (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, person_id INT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES person(person_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, user_id INT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES "user"(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE)
model.createProyect: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS proyect (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, status_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES status(status_id), name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL)
model.createProyectRole: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS proyect_role (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, proyect_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES proyect(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL)
model.createProyectRolePerson: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS proyect_role_person (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, proyect_role_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES proyect_role(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, person_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES person(person_id) ON DELETE CASCADE)
model.loadPermissionMethod: SELECT pm.profile_id, m.method_de, o.object_de, s.sub_system_de FROM permission_method pm INNER JOIN method m ON m.method_id = pm.method_id INNER JOIN object o ON o.object_id = m.object_id INNER JOIN sub_system s ON s.sub_system_id = o.sub_system_id
model.loadPermissionOption: SELECT po.profile_id, op.option_de FROM permission_option po INNER JOIN option op ON op.option_id = po.option_id
model.insertUserProfile: INSERT INTO user_profile (user_id, profile_id) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT (user_id, profile_id) DO NOTHING
model.insertAudit: INSERT INTO audit (user_id, date, hour, action, description) VALUES ($1, CURRENT_DATE, LOCALTIME, $2, $3)

model.seedStatusInactivo: INSERT INTO status (status_id, status_de) VALUES (2, 'Inactivo') ON CONFLICT (status_id) DO UPDATE SET status_de = EXCLUDED.status_de
model.seedStatusCulminado: INSERT INTO status (status_id, status_de) VALUES (3, 'Culminado') ON CONFLICT (status_id) DO UPDATE SET status_de = EXCLUDED.status_de
model.seedProfileAdmin: INSERT INTO profile (profile_id, profile_de) VALUES (1, 'Administrador') ON CONFLICT (profile_id) DO UPDATE SET profile_de = EXCLUDED.profile_de
model.seedProfileEmpleado: INSERT INTO profile (profile_id, profile_de) VALUES (2, 'Empleado') ON CONFLICT (profile_id) DO UPDATE SET profile_de = EXCLUDED.profile_de
model.seedProfileLider: INSERT INTO profile (profile_id, profile_de) VALUES (3, 'Líder de proyecto') ON CONFLICT (profile_id) DO UPDATE SET profile_de = EXCLUDED.profile_de
model.seedSubSystemSecurity: INSERT INTO sub_system (sub_system_id, sub_system_de) VALUES (1, 'security') ON CONFLICT (sub_system_id) DO NOTHING
model.seedSubSystemProyectos: INSERT INTO sub_system (sub_system_id, sub_system_de) VALUES (2, 'proyectos') ON CONFLICT (sub_system_id) DO NOTHING
model.seedObjectUser: INSERT INTO object (object_id, object_de, sub_system_id) VALUES (1, 'User', 1) ON CONFLICT (object_id) DO NOTHING
model.seedObjectUserProfile: INSERT INTO object (object_id, object_de, sub_system_id) VALUES (2, 'UserProfile', 1) ON CONFLICT (object_id) DO NOTHING
model.seedObjectPermission: INSERT INTO object (object_id, object_de, sub_system_id) VALUES (3, 'Permission', 1) ON CONFLICT (object_id) DO NOTHING
model.seedObjectProfile: INSERT INTO object (object_id, object_de, sub_system_id) VALUES (4, 'Profile', 1) ON CONFLICT (object_id) DO NOTHING
